thesis: This episode argues that large corporations survive and thrive by adopting 'startup thinking' and 'purpose-driven' attributes, often through buying innovation or spinning off new entities rather than creating it internally. It posits that companies with massive transformative purposes (MTPs) attract smart talent and scale faster, while those that fail to become platforms or transform into exponential organizations struggle to survive.
